summary: ALTER TABLE operation caused a database freeze due to lock contention.
mechanism: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN requires an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, which queued behind a long-lived weak lock, causing cascading lock contention.

facts.key: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN requires ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock
facts.evidence: PostgreSQL documentation and DBA post description.

facts.key: Weak lock held by idle transaction
facts.evidence: DBA post suggests idle-in-transaction connections may hold weak locks.
Post describes cascading lock contention after the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock request.

assumptions: The database schema and workload are representative of the described incident.
Idle-in-transaction connections are a plausible cause of weak locks.
unknowns: Exact workload and query patterns during the incident.
Whether other operations were running concurrently with the ALTER TABLE.
